corrections.critique: Strongest feature: The reply precisely isolates the invalid universalization from self-authenticating first-person existence to mind-accessible logical and mathematical principles governing reality necessarily. Principal limitation: Although diagnostically forceful, it primarily identifies the absent bridge rather than independently demonstrating whether those principles possess objective necessity, interpersonal authority, or metaphysical independence. Live burden: The opposing case must supply a non-question-begging general rule explaining why certainty regarding personal existence licenses universal descriptive and normative conclusions about logic and mathematics across reality. Locked score: Its exceptionally direct contact with the decisive inference, stable terminology, explicit scope, calibrated criticism, and resilience under the charitable possibility of a generalized self-validating rule justify placement at 92 within the very strong band.

Strongest feature: The reply sharply distinguishes an epistemic constraint on what one person can believe from a metaphysical conclusion concerning truth throughout every possible world. Principal limitation: Because the challenge remains principally interrogative, it exposes the missing connective principle without fully arguing that identity or arithmetic cannot themselves furnish an objective modal foundation. Live burden: The opposing case must distinguish necessary identity from private doxastic limitation and articulate a non-circular principle connecting individual cognition with universally necessary propositions. Locked score: Its explicit contact with both targeted claims, complete recoverability, stable modal scope, appropriately calibrated questioning, and charitable recognition that identity might be proposed as the bridge support a score of 92 within the very strong band.
